mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above the 3-month moving average indicates strengthening consumer demand and business confidence, which drives equity valuations higher through improved corporate earnings expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 3-month moving average, with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and boosting stock prices through lower discount rates applied to corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5% in a 3-month period, it signals deepening labor market contraction that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative equity returns as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% over a 3-month period, with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative equity returns as real rates rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY, with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a 'growth vs inflation' trade-off where central bank tightening risks trigger negative equity returns despite accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery (regime: 'post-shock recovery'), rising retail sales (RSAFS) above the 6-month moving average signals accelerating consumer spending that drives positive equity returns through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during 'post-shock recovery' when RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market expansion (regime: 'labor market expansion'), sustained non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) above 100k per month signals improving employment conditions that boost consumer confidence and drive positive equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during 'labor market expansion' when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below -2.0% annualized, it signals severe recession that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is below -2.0% annualized, with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
